description: Approve or deny a pending client tag, or prepare a new writer. decision prepare drafts a writer request: client, claimed tag, door (member or guest), reason, and correlation_id. Master Hub prepares that draft. The server validates it. Validation is a check and is not approval. Alex decides a new writer on /owner/chooser with the owner session. No AI grants a writer, including Master Hub and the retired owl account. The owner login may still approve or deny a pending client tag. Pending client tags are listed in emet_initialize and emet_status as client_approvals.

as.description: Required when the client_id already has approved tags: add keeps them all (several bots on one shared client); rename retires one

claimed_tag.description: For decision prepare: the tag the writer would be known by.

client.description: For decision prepare: the client id the writer request names.

correlation_id.description: For decision prepare: 16 lowercase hex characters. The same id again returns the retained request.

door.description: For decision prepare: member is a writer. Guest is not a writer.

from.description: With as=rename on a client that has several approved tags: the tag being replaced

reason.description: Note kept with the decision, or the reason on a prepared writer request.

tag.description: The pending client's tag, as listed in client_approvals.pending. For decision prepare, this is the claimed tag when claimed_tag is omitted.

name: emet_client_approve
